name: Topple
summary:
Topple is a free asymmetric action brawler for web browsers. One player controls a giant ape called a colossus, using motion controls in virtual reality or a keyboard and mouse, while up to four Fighters join from desktop or mobile browsers. Fighters choose from four classes and combine melee attacks and movement abilities to reach the colossus's vulnerable nape. The colossus can grab and throw Fighters, destroy buildings, and win by defeating the squad or toppling all four shrines.

The game features destructible and rebuildable environments, private online matches, ranked play, and solo survival with AI teammates. Both sides progress through character levels, talent trees, and equipment, across ink-and-paper arenas.
